description: Single source of truth for model IDs. parallel-review selects offline review tiers (1..2; unspecified/auto means L1), each with exactly two Pi reviewers in Codex then Claude order. Tier attempt budgets live in reviewTimeouts. Claude and OpenAI handle review and implementation; Grok is reserved for research. Roles name one model per consumer: .pi for Pi headless, .agy for Antigravity CLI (resolve with --field agy), .cursor for Cursor Agent CLI (resolve with --field cursor), .id for other tools such as Codex.
